subject.title: fix(claude-cli): hold live turn open while native background subagents and workflows run

question: Should Claude live sessions adopt system/background_tasks_changed as the authoritative completion gate for local_agent and local_workflow tasks despite that event schema being proven by live probes rather than a fully documented stable protocol?
rationale: The patch and real behavior proof are strong, but accepting an upstream lifecycle event as a runtime completion contract is an owner decision because future schema drift could delay channel delivery until timeout.

options.title: Confirm the contract and land
options.body: Accept the observed event lifecycle, refresh the branch onto current main, and land the bounded implementation with its focused tests and live proof.

options.title: Require a harder adapter boundary
options.body: Pause landing until Claude-specific event decoding and compatibility handling are isolated behind a typed adapter with an explicit unsupported-event failure policy.

recommendation.title: Confirm the contract and land
recommendation.body: Accept the observed event lifecycle, refresh the branch onto current main, and land the bounded implementation with its focused tests and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Claude live-runtime work plus ownership of the analogous merged Codex native-subagent lifecycle repair makes this the strongest cross-runtime decision route.
